name: Midori Timer
description: A timer whose duration you type: 25m, 1h30, 90s or 1:30, in a small window a hotkey can open. Shows as a thin line just inside an edge of the note that fills as the time runs, through a sage to ochre to wine gradient, so an empty channel is a timer just started and a full one is a timer about to end. It appears only while a timer is going, clears the status bar rather than running under it, and resets itself when the time is up. A status-bar readout is available instead of it or alongside it. Counts against an absolute deadline rather than decrementing a number, so it stays accurate while the window is in the background or the machine sleeps, and survives a restart.
author: Benjamin Loschen
